data.name: Luhaifa
data.gender_notes: Luhaifa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'al-haf', meaning 'breeze'. In Islamic tradition, Luhaifa is believed to symbolize the gentle touch of Allah's mercy and compassion. The name Luhaifa carries the meaning “Gentle breeze” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Luhaifa usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle breeze and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Luhaifa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle breeze.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Luhaifa total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: لوحيفة
in_arabic.meaning: لوحيفة اسم يعني الحسن والحسين في بعض التفاسير العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: لوحيفة هو اسم عربي يرمز في بعض التفاسير إلى الحسن والحسين، وقد ورد ذكره في بعض الآثار الإسلامية. يعتبر الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة وذات دلالة دينية

in_urdu.name: لوحیفہ
in_urdu.meaning: لوحیفہ نام حسن اور حسین کے معنی میں کچھ عرب تشریحات میں پایا جاتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: لوحیفہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو بعض تشریحات کے مطابق حسن اور حسین کے معنی رکھتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی روایات میں کچھ ذکر کے ساتھ منسلک ہے۔ یہ نام خوبصورت معانی اور دینی اہمیت کا حامل ہے

in_hindi.name: लुहैफा
in_hindi.meaning: लुहैफा नाम कुछ अरबी व्याख्याओं में حسن और हुसैन के अर्थ में आता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: लुहैफा एक अरबी नाम है जो कुछ व्याख्याओं के अनुसार حسن और हुसैन के अर्थ में है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपराओं में कुछ उल्लेख के साथ जुड़ा हुआ है। यह नाम सुंदर अर्थों और धार्मिक महत्व का वाहक है

in_pashto.name: لوحيفه
in_pashto.meaning: لوحيفه نوم په ځينو عربي تفسیرونو کې د حسن او حسین معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: لوحيفه د عربي نوم دی چې په ځينو تفسیرونو سره سم د حسن او حسین معنی لري. دا نوم په اسلامي دودونو کې د ځينو ذکر سره تړلی دی. دا نوم ښکلي معاني او مذهبي اهميت لري

in_english.name: Luhaifa
in_english.meaning: Luhaifa means beautiful, virtuous, or a variant of Hasan and Husain
in_english.long_meaning: Luhaifa is an Arabic name that, according to some interpretations, signifies beautiful, virtuous, or is considered a variant or related form to the names Hasan and Husain. The name is rooted in Arabic linguistic traditions and carries spiritual significance in Islamic culture. Etymologically, it relates to the Arabic root 'L-W-H' which implies 'to write' or 'tablet', suggesting a connection to knowledge and divine script. Historically, names like Luhaifa have been used to reflect positive attributes and aspirations for the child. In modern usage, Luhaifa remains a meaningful and culturally significant name across various Muslim communities
